properties.description: After a synchronous reset edge both response valids are cleared. Pre-edge presentations are not prematurely suppressed, and reset cancels queued expectations.
Every presented data byte is justified by previously accepted input, in order: retain the first eight bytes and append zero padding only after a short input frame completes.
Every presented data beat has the expected last marker: at byte four for padded frames, the original end for lengths four through eight, and byte eight for truncated frames.
Every presented status matches the oldest completed input frame, independently of data acceptance, including original length, adjusted length, padding and truncation flags.
A blocked data response retains valid, data and last across clock edges until acceptance, except when a synchronous reset cancels it.
A blocked status response retains valid and all status fields across clock edges until acceptance or reset, independently of data-channel progress.
